Management Plan
- management_plan_main_or_not_recorded: 
  - Continue ice therapy as currently used
  - Advise easing back on running; do not run through pain if pain worsens
  - Ibuprofen can be taken; consider a slightly stronger anti-inflammatory prescribed for regular use instead of ibuprofen, but not with ibuprofen; take with food
  - Arrange knee examination; refer to physiotherapist for comprehensive knee assessment
  - Consider imaging (e.g., knee imaging) if physiotherapist assessment suggests need
  - If persistent swelling, warmth, redness, fever, or knee fully locks, urgent medical review and contact back
  - Pharmacy to receive prescription for stronger anti-inflammatory; clinic to send referral as appropriate
  - If appointment wait times are long, clinic can see the patient in person
